senses.en: presenting a general summary or overall view

example.en: The report gives a synoptic overview of the year's events.
example.zh: 这份报告对全年事件作了概括性的综述。

senses.en: relating to gymnastics or physical exercise

example.en: She showed impressive gymnastic ability.
example.zh: 她展现出令人印象深刻的体操能力。

senses.en: actively agile or energetic

example.en: He made a gymnastic leap over the fence.
example.zh: 他敏捷地跃过栅栏。

senses.en: in a poetic or expressive manner

example.en: She sang lyrically, and the audience fell silent.
example.zh: 她唱得深情动人，观众都安静了下来。

senses.en: describing a disease that spreads easily from person to person

example.en: Chickenpox is highly catching among young children.
example.zh: 水痘在幼儿中传染性很强。

senses.en: (of an emotion or behavior) easily passed on to others

example.en: Her laughter was catching, and soon everyone was smiling.
example.zh: 她的笑声很有感染力，很快大家都笑了。

senses.en: a person who operates a film or slide projector

example.en: The projectionist started the film on time.
example.zh: 放映员准时开始放映电影。

senses.en: (formal) to refer to something briefly

example.en: He adverted to the earlier dispute in his speech.
example.zh: 他在演讲中提到了早先的争执。

senses.en: (British, informal) an advertisement

example.en: She saw an advert for a cheap flight to Rome.
example.zh: 她看到一则飞往罗马的特价航班广告。

senses.en: a person who illegally breaks into a house to steal
senses.zh: 闯入民宅行窃者；入室盗贼

example.en: The police arrested the housebreaker early the next morning.
example.zh: 警方第二天一早逮捕了这名入室盗贼。

senses.en: title for a doctor or holder of a doctorate

example.en: Dr Lee will see you in a few minutes.
example.zh: 李医生几分钟后就来见您。

senses.en: an expert in the study of religion and the nature of God

example.en: The theologian wrote several books on medieval Christianity.
example.zh: 这位神学家写了好几本关于中世纪基督教的书。

senses.en: the activity of an organization of reaching out to help or involve more people
senses.zh: 外展服务；扩大服务范围

example.en: The clinic runs an outreach program for rural families.
example.zh: 该诊所为农村家庭开展外展服务项目。

senses.en: paper or plastic covering around something

example.en: He unwrapped the candy and threw the wrapper away.
example.zh: 他剥开糖果，把包装纸扔掉了。

senses.en: (old-fashioned) a loose dressing gown or robe

example.en: She answered the door in her wrapper.
example.zh: 她穿着宽松的晨衣去开门。

senses.en: (computing) software that provides an interface around another program or component

example.en: The library provides a wrapper around the existing API.
example.zh: 这个库为现有 API 提供了封装接口。

senses.en: a natural skill or clever way of doing something

example.en: He has a knack for making people feel comfortable.
example.zh: 他有让人感到自在的诀窍。

senses.en: pale red in color

example.en: She wore a pink dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿着一条粉红色的连衣裙去参加聚会。

senses.en: a pale red color

example.en: Pink is her favorite color.
example.zh: 粉红色是她最喜欢的颜色。

senses.en: in sewing, to cut a zigzag edge on fabric to help prevent fraying
senses.zh: 在（布料边缘）剪出锯齿状边以防脱线

example.en: The tailor pinked the edge of the fabric to prevent fraying.
example.zh: 裁缝把布料边缘剪成锯齿状以防脱线。

senses.en: the legal ending of a marriage

example.en: The couple filed for divorce after living apart for a year.
example.zh: 这对夫妻分居一年后申请离婚。

senses.en: to legally end a marriage

example.en: She decided to divorce her husband after years of conflict.
example.zh: 多年冲突后，她决定与丈夫离婚。

senses.en: to separate something from something else; to break an association

example.en: It is hard to divorce economic policy from social effects.
example.zh: 很难将经济政策与社会影响分开。

senses.en: an aircraft powered by jet engines

example.en: The passenger jet landed smoothly.
example.zh: 这架客机平稳着陆。

senses.en: a fast stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening

example.en: A jet of water shot from the cracked pipe.
example.zh: 一股水流从破裂的管道中喷出。

senses.en: to come out or send out in a fast stream

example.en: Steam jetted from the kettle.
example.zh: 蒸汽从水壶中喷出。

senses.en: a set of beliefs or principles taught by a religion, political party, or other group

example.en: The church's doctrine emphasizes forgiveness and compassion.
example.zh: 该教会的教义强调宽恕与怜悯。

senses.en: the act or process of changing position or place

example.en: The movement of the boat made her feel dizzy.
example.zh: 船的晃动让她感到头晕。

senses.en: an organized group of people working toward a shared aim
senses.zh: 运动；有共同目标的活动团体

example.en: The environmental movement has gained support among young people.
example.zh: 环保运动在年轻人中获得了支持。

senses.en: a main section of a musical work

example.en: The second movement of the symphony is slow and quiet.
example.zh: 这部交响曲的第二乐章缓慢而安静。

senses.en: to show clearly that something is true using evidence or examples

example.en: The study demonstrates that regular exercise improves sleep.
example.zh: 这项研究表明，规律锻炼能改善睡眠。

senses.en: to show how to do something by doing it yourself

example.en: The teacher demonstrated how to use the microscope.
example.zh: 老师示范了如何使用显微镜。

senses.en: to take part in a public protest

example.en: Hundreds of people demonstrated outside the council building.
example.zh: 数百人在议会大楼外示威。

senses.en: cruel or violent treatment of a person or animal

example.en: The charity provides shelter for children who have suffered abuse.
example.zh: 该慈善机构为遭受虐待的儿童提供住所。

senses.en: improper or harmful use of something, such as power or drugs

example.en: The investigation found widespread abuse of power.
example.zh: 调查发现权力被广泛滥用。

senses.en: to treat a person or animal cruelly or violently

example.en: The organization works to protect animals that have been abused.
example.zh: 该组织致力于保护遭受虐待的动物。

senses.en: helpful or beneficial for a purpose

example.en: This guide contains useful information for new students.
example.zh: 这本指南包含对新生有用的信息。

senses.en: to provide food or nutrients to help a person, animal, or plant grow

example.en: Good soil and sunlight nourish the plants.
example.zh: 良好的土壤和阳光滋养着植物。

senses.en: to keep a feeling or belief alive in your mind

example.en: She still nourishes the hope of returning to her hometown.
example.zh: 她仍怀着回到家乡的希望。

senses.en: a wide open area of wild grassy or heather-covered land

example.en: They walked across the moor in the morning fog.
example.zh: 他们在晨雾中走过那片荒野。

senses.en: to tie a boat to a dock or anchor it in place

example.en: We moored the boat at the small harbor overnight.
example.zh: 我们把船在小港口停泊过夜。

collocations: moor a ship to the dock

senses.en: (Moor, capitalized) a Muslim person of North African origin who ruled parts of Spain in the Middle Ages

example.en: The Moors ruled much of Spain for centuries.
example.zh: 摩尔人统治西班牙大部分地区达数个世纪。

senses.en: very; extremely (used as an intensifier)

example.en: I'm terribly sorry for the delay.
example.zh: 非常抱歉让你久等了。

senses.en: in a terrible or very bad way

example.en: The experiment went terribly wrong.
example.zh: 实验出了严重的问题。

senses.en: up to a certain time

example.en: The shop stays open till nine o'clock.
example.zh: 商店营业到九点。

senses.en: to prepare land for growing crops by ploughing it

example.en: Farmers till the soil before planting seeds.
example.zh: 农民在播种前翻耕土壤。

senses.en: a drawer or machine for keeping money in a shop

example.en: The cashier put the money in the till.
example.zh: 收银员把钱放进了收银机。

senses.en: up to the time when; until

example.en: Wait here till I come back.
example.zh: 在这里等我回来。

senses.en: a person who brings a legal case against someone in court

example.en: The plaintiff is seeking compensation for the damage.
example.zh: 原告正在就损失寻求赔偿。

senses.en: something used to make a place or thing more attractive

example.en: We put up colorful decorations for the party.
example.zh: 我们为聚会挂起了五彩缤纷的装饰品。

senses.en: a medal or award given for achievement or bravery

example.en: The soldier received a decoration for his courage.
example.zh: 这名士兵因勇敢获得了一枚勋章。

senses.en: able to cause death; deadly

example.en: The snake's venom is lethal to small animals.
example.zh: 这种蛇的毒液对小动物是致命的。

senses.en: final and unable to be changed; conclusive

example.en: The committee issued a definitive report on the accident.
example.zh: 委员会就事故发布了最终报告。

senses.en: recognized as the best or most authoritative of its kind

example.en: Her book is the definitive biography of the poet.
example.zh: 她的书是这位诗人最权威的传记。

senses.en: a practical attitude of accepting facts as they are

example.en: Her realism helped the team set achievable goals.
example.zh: 她的务实态度帮助团队设定了可实现的目标。

senses.en: a style in art or literature that depicts things as they really are

example.en: The novel is admired for its stark realism.
example.zh: 这部小说因其冷峻的现实主义而受到赞誉。

senses.en: an expression of gratitude

example.en: She sent a card to express her thanks.
example.zh: 她寄了一张卡片表达谢意。

senses.en: a short way to say thank you

example.en: Thanks for helping me move the box.
example.zh: 谢谢你帮我搬这个箱子。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Nicholas is my cousin's name.
example.zh: 尼古拉斯是我表哥的名字。

senses.en: Saint Nicholas, a 4th-century bishop associated with Santa Claus
senses.zh: 圣尼古拉斯（4世纪主教，圣诞老人的原型）

example.en: Saint Nicholas was known for secretly giving gifts to the poor.
example.zh: 圣尼古拉斯以暗中给穷人送礼物而闻名。

senses.en: in or to a foreign country

example.en: She plans to study abroad next year.
example.zh: 她计划明年出国留学。

senses.en: a large country house or castle in France, especially one used for wine production

example.en: They visited a famous chateau in Bordeaux last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天他们参观了波尔多一座著名的葡萄酒庄。

senses.en: to agree to a request or demand

example.en: The board finally acceded to the workers' demands.
example.zh: 董事会最终同意了工人的要求。

senses.en: to formally take office or join a treaty or organization

example.en: The king acceded to the throne in 1952.
example.zh: 国王于1952年即位。

senses.en: a person's or couple's first child
senses.zh: 第一个孩子；长子或长女

example.en: Their firstborn is starting school this year.
example.zh: 他们的第一个孩子今年开始上学。

senses.en: born first in a family

example.en: She is her parents' firstborn child.
example.zh: 她是父母的第一个孩子。

senses.en: very small; relating to or expressed as a fraction of a whole

example.en: The fee is only a fractional part of the total cost.
example.zh: 这笔费用只占总成本的一小部分。

senses.en: the process or amount of becoming smaller

example.en: Wool shrinkage after washing can be significant.
example.zh: 羊毛洗后收缩可能很明显。

senses.en: a ship equipped for use in war

example.en: A navy warship patrolled the coast.
example.zh: 一艘海军军舰在海岸巡逻。

senses.en: an adult male sheep

example.en: A ram stood on the hillside with the flock.
example.zh: 一只公羊和羊群站在山坡上。

senses.en: to crash into something with great force

example.en: The truck rammed the gate.
example.zh: 卡车猛撞上了大门。

senses.en: a device used for striking or forcing something

example.en: Workers used a ram to pack the soil firmly.
example.zh: 工人们用夯锤把土压实。

senses.en: a playing card of the suit chosen to beat the other suits in a card game

example.en: He played his trump card and won the hand.
example.zh: 他打出王牌，赢了这一局。

senses.en: to beat or surpass something by using a stronger argument or advantage

example.en: Safety concerns trump cost considerations in this project.
example.zh: 在这个项目中，安全问题比成本考量更重要。

senses.en: to understand something difficult after much thought

example.en: I couldn't fathom why he left so suddenly.
example.zh: 我无法理解他为何突然离开。

senses.en: a unit of water depth equal to six feet (about 1.8 meters)

example.en: The sea is thirty fathoms deep here.
example.zh: 这里的海水深三十英寻。

senses.en: a cheap place where travelers, especially young people, can stay overnight, often sharing rooms
senses.zh: 青年旅舍；廉价的招待所

example.en: We stayed in a youth hostel near the train station.
example.zh: 我们住在火车站附近的一家青年旅舍。

senses.en: an unspecified amount or number of something

example.en: I need some water.
example.zh: 我需要一些水。

senses.en: an unspecified number or amount of people or things

example.en: Some of the students were late.
example.zh: 一些学生迟到了。

senses.en: approximately; about

example.en: Some 50 people attended the meeting.
example.zh: 大约50人参加了会议。

senses.en: a room or floor below ground level in a building

example.en: We store old boxes in the basement.
example.zh: 我们把旧箱子存放在地下室里。

senses.en: the senior ministers of a government who advise the leader

example.en: The prime minister called a cabinet meeting to discuss the budget.
example.zh: 首相召开内阁会议讨论预算。

senses.en: a piece of furniture with shelves or drawers for storing things

example.en: She kept the plates in a glass cabinet.
example.zh: 她把盘子放在玻璃柜里。

senses.en: belonging to us; used before a noun

example.en: Our house is near the park.
example.zh: 我们的房子在公园附近。

senses.en: the non-physical part of a person, often thought to survive death
senses.zh: 人的灵魂或精神，常被认为在死后存在

example.en: She believed his spirit was still with her.
example.zh: 她相信他的灵魂仍与她同在。

senses.en: energy, enthusiasm, or mood

example.en: The team's spirit rose after the goal.
example.zh: 进球后球队的士气高涨。

senses.en: a strong alcoholic drink

example.en: The shop sells wine and spirits.
example.zh: 这家店出售葡萄酒和烈酒。

senses.en: to carry someone or something away secretly or mysteriously

example.en: The documents were spirited out of the country.
example.zh: 这些文件被秘密带出了该国。

senses.en: bread that has been heated until brown and crisp

example.en: I had toast and coffee for breakfast.
example.zh: 我早餐吃了吐司，喝了咖啡。

senses.en: to make bread brown and crisp by heating

example.en: She toasted two slices of bread.
example.zh: 她烤了两片面包。

senses.en: an act of raising a glass and drinking to honor someone or something

example.en: Everyone raised their glasses in a toast to the newlyweds.
example.zh: 大家举杯祝新婚夫妇幸福。

senses.en: to raise a glass and drink in honor of someone

example.en: They toasted the team's success.
example.zh: 他们举杯庆祝球队的成功。

senses.en: a long narrow ditch dug in the ground

example.en: Workers dug a trench to lay the pipes.
example.zh: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。

senses.en: a long narrow hole dug by soldiers for protection in war

example.en: The soldiers hid in a trench during the attack.
example.zh: 进攻期间士兵们藏在战壕里。

senses.en: a long deep narrow area at the bottom of the ocean

example.en: The Mariana Trench contains the deepest known part of the ocean.
example.zh: 马里亚纳海沟内有海洋中已知最深的区域。

senses.en: to help settle a disagreement between parties

example.en: The UN tried to mediate between the two countries.
example.zh: 联合国试图在两国之间进行斡旋。

senses.en: to be the means of bringing something about; to act as a link between things

example.en: The broker mediated the sale of the property.
example.zh: 经纪人促成了这处房产的出售。

senses.en: relevant to a situation; able to be applied

example.en: This rule is not applicable to students.
example.zh: 这条规则不适用于学生。

senses.en: the way a word is written with letters; the act of writing words correctly

example.en: Could you check the spelling of my name?
example.zh: 你能检查一下我名字的拼写吗？

senses.en: a long narrow part of a machine that turns and passes on power

example.en: The broken shaft stopped the factory machine.
example.zh: 断裂的轴使工厂的机器停了下来。

senses.en: a long narrow vertical passage, such as in a mine or for an elevator

example.en: The miners went down the shaft in a lift.
example.zh: 矿工们乘电梯下到矿井。

senses.en: the long narrow stem of an arrow

example.en: He carefully straightened the shaft of the arrow.
example.zh: 他小心地把箭杆弄直。

senses.en: to trick or treat someone unfairly (informal)

example.en: The workers felt shafted by the new contract.
example.zh: 工人们觉得被新合同坑了。

senses.en: the dead body of an animal

example.en: A bird's carcass lay on the ground.
example.zh: 一只鸟的尸体躺在地上。

senses.en: the body of a slaughtered animal prepared for food

example.en: The carcass was sent to the meat plant.
example.zh: 胴体被送到了肉类加工厂。

senses.en: moving or happening quickly

example.en: We wish you a speedy recovery.
example.zh: 我们祝你早日康复。

senses.en: to attack or touch someone sexually

example.en: He was charged with molesting a child.
example.zh: 他被指控猥亵儿童。

senses.en: to bother or disturb someone repeatedly (formal, now rare)

example.en: In older legal texts, molest meant to harass or disturb someone.
example.zh: 在较早的法律文本中，molest 意为骚扰或妨碍某人。

senses.en: to make something legal by changing the law

example.en: The country voted to legalize the sale of the product.
example.zh: 该国投票通过将这种产品的销售合法化。

senses.en: the activity of farming, especially caring for crops and animals

example.en: Good animal husbandry keeps livestock healthy.
example.zh: 良好的畜牧管理能保持牲畜健康。

senses.en: cosmetic surgery on the face to reduce signs of aging

example.en: She decided to have a facelift last year.
example.zh: 她去年决定做面部整容手术。

senses.en: a renovation that improves the outward appearance of something

example.en: The old theater got a facelift before the festival.
example.zh: 老剧院在节日前进行了外观翻新。

senses.en: (of hair) formed in small tight curls

example.en: Her hair becomes frizzy in humid weather.
example.zh: 潮湿天气里她的头发会变得毛卷。

senses.en: the altitude or latitude above which trees cannot grow
senses.zh: 树木线；林木线（树木生长的上限）

example.en: Above the treeline, only grass and moss survive.
example.zh: 在树木线以上，只有草和苔藓能够生存。

senses.en: a liquid medicine or magic drink
senses.zh: 药水；（魔法）药剂；一剂饮剂

example.en: The witch brewed a magic potion.
example.zh: 女巫熬制了一瓶魔法药剂。

senses.en: smooth and shiny like glass
senses.zh: 如玻璃般的；光滑光亮的

example.en: The lake was glassy in the morning.
example.zh: 清晨的湖面平静如镜。

senses.en: (of eyes) dull and lacking expression

example.en: The tired patient had a glassy stare.
example.zh: 疲惫的病人眼神呆滞。

senses.en: having low moral standards and enjoying too many pleasures

example.en: Critics called the period a decadent age of art and culture.
example.zh: 评论家称那个时代是艺术与文化颓废的时期。

senses.en: extremely rich and pleasure-giving, often describing food
senses.zh: 奢华享乐的；香浓诱人的（常指食物）

example.en: She treated herself to a decadent chocolate cake.
example.zh: 她款待自己吃了一块浓香诱人的巧克力蛋糕。

senses.en: a person considered morally or culturally decadent

example.en: The novel portrays the decadents of Parisian society.
example.zh: 这部小说刻画了巴黎上流社会中的颓废派。

senses.en: all future generations of people

example.en: We should protect the environment for the sake of posterity.
example.zh: 我们应该为了子孙后代保护环境。

senses.en: a person's descendants

example.en: He left his estate to his posterity.
example.zh: 他把遗产留给了自己的后代。

senses.en: not controlled or restrained

example.en: The news was met with unbridled enthusiasm.
example.zh: 这则消息受到了毫无保留的热情欢迎。
